recognize_zh: 中央一顆中性球的細胞質被一大團均質、無染色質紋理的淡紫色圓形核物質（LE body / hematoxylin body）填滿，自身分葉核被擠到細胞邊緣呈新月狀，這就是典型 LE 細胞。
features: Neutrophil containing a large, round, homogeneous, smooth pale purple inclusion (LE body)
Ingested nuclear material lacks any chromatin pattern
Neutrophil's own lobulated nucleus compressed and displaced to the periphery (crescent)
Adjacent lymphocyte and a vacuolated neutrophil/macrophage with cytoplasmic debris
describe_en: High-power view of synovial fluid cytospin shows a neutrophil whose cytoplasm is largely occupied by a round, homogeneous, structureless pale purple mass, displacing its lobulated nucleus into a peripheral crescent. An adjacent lymphocyte and a vacuolated phagocyte with cytoplasmic debris are also present. The ingested material shows no residual chromatin pattern, distinguishing it from a phagocytosed intact cell. Findings are consistent with an LE cell, supporting systemic lupus erythematosus (or drug-induced lupus) in the appropriate serologic context.

ddx.vs: In a tart cell (usually a macrophage) the engulfed nucleus retains a visible chromatin pattern and often a rim of cytoplasm, unlike the homogeneous smooth LE body.
Ragocytes contain multiple small dark refractile cytoplasmic granules of immune complexes rather than one large homogeneous inclusion.
An engulfed apoptotic cell shows dense pyknotic nuclear fragments with surrounding cytoplasm, not a pale, swollen, structureless nuclear mass.
